review_comment: The code disables a user's password without verifying that the requester has authorization to perform this action. An attacker could submit a password reset request for any email address, effectively bypassing authentication for that account. Add an authorization check to ensure only authorized users can reset passwords.

The code retrieves a user by email and sets their password as unusable without verifying if the current user is authorized to perform this action. The patch introduces persistence of the modified user object, enabling an attacker to lock out any user account by submitting their email address. Add authorization verification before modifying user passwords to ensure only authorized actors can reset passwords for other users.

The code assigns an email from user input directly to a user variable without verifying that the user has authorization to reset that specific email's password. This bypasses proper authorization checks and allows any email to be used for password reset. Add authorization verification to ensure only authorized users can reset passwords for specific accounts.
